text: 中国人民银行：为支持外资人民币业务清算行做好流动性管理、更好服务境外人民币业务，境外央行类机构回购工具的操作对象纳入外资人民币业务清算行，操作要素按照现行境外央行类机构回购工具执行。
text_en: PBOC: To support foreign-funded RMB business clearing banks in liquidity management and better serve offshore RMB business, foreign central bank-type institutions' repo tool counterparties will include foreign-funded RMB business clearing banks, with operating parameters in line with the existing repo tool for foreign central bank-type institutions.
